motion: Social media companies should be required to label AI-generated content

candidate.text: Ultimately, this debate comes down to a choice between a proactive defense and a dangerous illusion of safety. We have shown that an imperfect, easily bypassed labeling system does not protect users; it actively misleads them.

framework.core_dispute: Whether mandatory labeling provides genuine digital safety or merely creates a false sense of security while sacrificing privacy.
framework.reason: The speaker is delivering a closing statement for the AGAINST side, framing the final verdict around the failure of the opponent's imperfect system.
